source.title: HST OPAL Cycle 32 Saturn 2025a F395N/F502N/F631N global map
source.credit: NASA / ESA / HST OPAL Team (PI Amy Simon) / STScI; adapted by Starward

processing: Starward took the RGB median across valid longitudes in each planetographic latitude row of the historical three-filter map, omitted rows with under 90% coverage including ring-obscured latitudes, and resized the resulting latitude profile to 8x512 RGBA PNG. This is an adaptation under CC BY 4.0.
limitations: Historical band colors from an arbitrarily scaled three-filter composite, not natural color or live Saturnian weather.
Longitude-dependent clouds and 2025 moon/shadow positions were removed; no current feature longitude is claimed.
Transparent polar and ring-obscured rows lack source atmosphere coverage and must fall back to the plain computed globe.
